meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Sangvi | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching at our head office in Krishna Nagar, New Sangvi, where D-SAP Ghule Tutorials began in {{fact:org.founded#year}}. Faculty from Kota.

intro: Our head office is in Krishna Nagar, New Sangvi. D-SAP Ghule Tutorials started here in {{fact:org.founded#year}}, so for families in Sangvi the centre is close to home.

sections.heading: Finding the head office
body: The centre is on Krishna Nagar Road Number 2. From anywhere in Old or New Sangvi it is a short ride.

body.text: The Rajiv Gandhi Bridge connects Sangvi with Aundh, which is why Aundh students come here too.

sections.heading: Where we began

body.text: Students from Mastermind High School and Tannu School in New Sangvi study with us.

body: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} at the head office means a Sangvi student can stay on and study once class is over.

body.text: Sangvi students can begin JEE preparation in Class 11 with the two-year programme, or in Class 12 with the one-year programme.

questions.q: Is New Sangvi the main centre?
questions.a: Yes. It is our head office and the place D-SAP Ghule Tutorials started in {{fact:org.founded#year}}.

questions.q: Do students from Sangvi schools study here?

a.text: Yes, including students from Mastermind High School and Tannu School.

questions.q: Can my child study at the centre after class?
questions.a: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} is at the head office for quiet study. Ask us about the times it is open.
